name: Sacred Flame
description:
Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage. You may target a creature you can not see if you can instead see an open space above them.

**At Higher Levels.** The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
